theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_exists_smooth_unit_form_support_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → (∀ z, covectorEuclideanNorm (f z) ≤ 1) → ∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ → ∃ h : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, IsTestForm h ∧ support h ⊆ support f ∧ (∀ z, covectorEuclideanNorm (h z) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ z, covectorEuclideanNorm (h z - f z) ≤ κ
